name: overlay-player
description: A floating, always-on-top YouTube overlay for macOS and Windows. Next.js UI + API in one Electron app.
author: Sandeep M S

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n next,electron -c cyan,magenta "next dev -p 3000" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:3000 && node scripts/start-electron.mjs"
scripts.dist: npm run icons && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run icons && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run icons && npm run build && electron-builder --win

//: next/react live in devDependencies on purpose: the packaged app runs the standalone server, which ships its own pruned node_modules as an extra resource. Listing them as runtime dependencies would make electron-builder bundle a second ~45MB copy into the asar.
